value.text: Historical run summary retained. Detailed run artefacts have moved out of the development tracker. docs/proposer-transfer-receipt.json and its documented explicit scratch command reconstruct the public projections and native version-two root, ten shards, replay plan and measured evaluations; the original version-one addresses in this summary are historical provenance. Scratch replay reproduced both reports with zero new fits and no change to the underpowered refusal.
